messages:
nora: Heads-up: marketplace partners have started asking about our planned auth header change (X-API-Key -> Authorization: Bearer). We need a partner-friendly bridge plan.
aj: Good catch. Do we have a compatibility layer today? I thought we supported both in the API gateway.
diego: Gateway accepts both, but SDKs and marketplace connectors vary. Some marketplace listings still advertise X-API-Key and SI installers hardcode it.
maya: Proposal: add a temporary 'auth-bridge' header in the ingress that accepts X-API-Key, translates to bearer internally, and emits an opt-in audit header 'x-auth-bridged'. Gate it per-partner/sku.
nora: Love the opt-in gate. Timeline idea: enable bridge for flagged partners now, announce deprecation with 90-day window, and then remove bridge for non-opt-ins after 90 days.
aj: I'll add a routing flag: "accept_legacy_api_key": true/false and a metric "auth_bridge.accepted". Also add alerting for auth failures spike and unusual token reuse.
diego: Marketplace actions: update integration manifest with "legacy_auth_supported": true, add a banner on the listing, and add a one-click opt-in toggle for partners. Also prepare handbook text for SIs to reconfigure installers.
maya: SDKs: will ship 3 small patches: 1) deprecation warnings when using X-API-Key, 2) helper to auto-migrate to Authorization header, 3) snippet for server-side token exchange. Example snippet for comms:

```
// server proxy: exchange X-API-Key -> Bearer
const key = req.headers['x-api-key']
if (key) {
  req.headers['authorization'] = `Bearer ${transform(key)}`
}
```

Keep language-agnostic in notification.
nora: Legal/PD: ensure we don't change token semantics (scopes, TTL). Diego, can marketplace ops display the token policy in the banner?
diego: Yes, will include scope/TTL detail and link to audit logs. Also will add a checkbox for partners to request extended migration help.
nora: Partner comms draft: short advisory, migration guide, SDK links, and an opt-in form for bridge. Partner-bot: schedule preview to partners next Tue 2025-04-15 17:00 UTC.
partner-bot: Draft partner advisory scheduled for 2025-04-15 17:00 UTC (status: draft).
aj: Action items: aj -> routing flag + alerts + runbook; maya -> SDK patches + migration helpers; diego -> marketplace banner + opt-in toggle + listing updates; nora -> partner advisory + legal clearance. I'll post PRs and runbook links here when ready.
nora: Thanks all. Aim to have bridge and opt-in UI live before advisory. Will track progress in #partnerships-ops and set up 1:1s for top marketplace partners. :thumbsup:
